claims: FUN_0022fda8 writes 0x5cc to the global later read by FUN_00128ca0: it forms 0x2e60, shifts it right by three, and stores it at gp-0x6dec.

FUN_00128ca0 forms a VIF command word by ORing 0x14000000 with the gp-0x6dec value and writes that word into its shared packet buffer; with the pinned PS2SDK encoding, command byte 0x14 denotes MSCAL.

For the guarded VIF1 overlay map, MSCAL address 0x5cc corresponds to VU byte address 0x2e60, which lies at local byte offset 0x660 in overlay 5's [0x2800,0x3000) range; the 16 source bytes at ELF file offset 0x11ba78 match the extracted overlay bytes.

At VU address 0x2e60, the disassembled program loads VF01 through VF08 from VU addresses 0 through 7, obtains TOP into VI01, then later reaches a Q divide using VF00.w / VF17.w, multiplies VF17.xyz by Q, and applies FTOI4 to VF16.xyz in the next overlay chunk. This supports only that those instructions are present in this bounded entry span.

The same VU entry span contains LOI 768 followed by SUBI.xyz and MUL.xyz on VF15, and LOI 6144 followed by SUBI.xy on VF12; these instruction facts do not by themselves establish a serialized-coordinate normalization scale.

The root's scratch exploration of 16,018 nonempty groups reports that the per-axis max-absolute-bound divided by 16,384 hypothesis leaves 1,051 outside endpoint bounds even with one hypothetical quantization step, so that scale hypothesis is rejected.
